headline: Binance has published a first proof that its main coins are fully backed after the hack, with a broader check due later this week, as bitcoin sits near $78K before Tuesday's US midterms.

market.asOf: Read about 15:58 UTC Mon 2 Nov (22:58 Bangkok) from CoinMarketCap; Alternative.me showed BTC $78,078 (+0.24%) at the same time. Use the live prices at the top of the page.
market.fearGreed: 37 (Fear), up from 34 yesterday, on the Alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index; CoinMarketCap's own index shows 36 (Fear)

stories.title: Binance publishes a first post-hack proof of reserves; the broader check comes later this week
stories.summary: Binance has completed a zero-knowledge proof (a public check that customer balances are backed) for its 31 Oct snapshot, covering 10 major coins. A broader snapshot follows on Wed 4 Nov, and that proof takes another 40 to 50 hours. More withdrawal networks reopen from Tuesday.
points: The proof covers BTC, ETH, USDT, BNB, SOL, USDC, XRP, USD1, RLUSD and ZEC, each backed at least 1:1, using a snapshot from 00:00 UTC on 31 Oct, per crypto.news.
Binance says it has replaced about 95% of the stolen coins, up from 80% on 30 Oct and 90% on 31 Oct; the last 5% is in less liquid tokens, per crypto.news.

Binance's own count for 1:00am to 10:30am ET on 1 Nov: $4.65B withdrawn and $1.01B deposited, a $3.64B net outflow, about 2.1% of $171B, per The Block. DefiLlama data cited by Bitcoinist shows about $6.1B out over 24 hours; Binance disputes some outside figures.
Rivals gained: OKX about $450M net and Bybit about $134M, per Bitcoinist.
Phase 2 withdrawals (more networks and assets) start Tuesday 3 Nov; the token list and times are not yet published, per crypto.news.

stories.title: 44% of the stolen Binance funds are frozen; the rest is spread over 950+ wallets
stories.summary: Blockchain analytics firm Elliptic says the hackers, whom the FBI ties to North Korea, used about 20 automated services to move the funds in under three days. Almost half is frozen or seized, but most of the rest is in bitcoin and ether, which no company can freeze.
points: Elliptic puts the theft at $6.4B, with about $2.85B (44%) frozen or seized and about $3.28B still held across 950+ wallets, per CoinDesk. Binance gives about $3B frozen, per crypto.news.
Six cross-chain bridges were first used within a 100-minute window on 30 Oct, per CoinDesk.
Very little has been turned into cash so far, per CoinDesk.
Tether froze about $378.7M of USDT, and about $242M was routed through Tron, per Bloomingbit.

sources.label: CoinDesk: funds spread across thousands of wallets

stories.title: Strategy buys 811 more bitcoin as prices hold near $78K before the midterms
stories.summary: Strategy bought 811 BTC for about $65.5M last week, but spent more buying back its own preferred shares. Bitcoin is just above last week's low going into Tuesday's US midterm elections and Friday's jobs report.
points: Strategy bought 811 BTC at an average of $80,846 between 26 Oct and 1 Nov, bringing it to 849,327 BTC, per Cointelegraph and The Block.
It also spent $208.2M buying back STRC preferred shares, partly funded by selling about 1.18M MSTR shares for $164M, per Cointelegraph.
October closed down 7.3%, bitcoin's worst October since 2014, and last week's low was about $76,300, per Cointelegraph.
Kalshi gave Democrats a 93.6% chance of winning the House, per Cointelegraph.

sources.label: Cointelegraph: three things for bitcoin this week

briefs.title: Bitmine adds more ether
briefs.summary: Bitmine bought 8,573 ETH last week, taking it to 6,060,506 ETH, with 86% staked, per The Block.

briefs.title: BTCPay: no drains reported on latest version
briefs.summary: BTCPay Server says the attack it found affects versions 2.4.1 and older, with no credible reports of hot-wallet drains on the latest 2.4.7; no loss total yet, per Unchained.

briefs.title: Strive buys 124 BTC
briefs.summary: Strive added 124 BTC (about $10M) between 24 and 30 Oct, bringing it to 43,124 BTC, per The Block.

briefs.title: THORChain halts most chains after an Ethereum reorg
briefs.summary: A separate Ethereum reorg halted 10 of THORChain's 13 chains and RUNE fell 18.4% to $0.507, per CryptoTicker.

briefs.title: Ripple releases 1B XRP from escrow
briefs.summary: Ripple released 1B XRP from escrow on 1 Nov; none had been re-locked as of 10:50 UTC that day, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: CFTC takes comments on leveraged retail crypto
briefs.summary: The CFTC's proposed federal route for leveraged retail crypto trading is open for public comment until 14 Dec 2026, per crypto.news.
